Gold-Template ships **thirty selectable templates**: **seventeen frozen upstream core
designs** and **thirteen GoldApp custom designs**. The core set stays byte-locked for
reproducibility; the custom set is deliberately unlocked so GoldApp can evolve it
without weakening the upstream locks.

Every design uses the same shared runtime contract and is selectable from the installer
or manager.

## What every template shares

Whichever you choose, you get the same guarantees. These come from the shared runtime,
not from any individual design:

- **One self-contained artifact.** CSS, JavaScript, the fonts and the QR generator are
  all inlined. The page fetches nothing from anywhere.
- **The same runtime.** A template is a layout and a stylesheet set, never a fork of the
  logic.
- **The same data.** Status, traffic, expiry, configurations and clients are identical
  across all thirty.
- **Right-to-left support**, and **dark and light themes**.
- **79 required hooks**, deterministic builds, and a **280 KiB hard artifact ceiling**.
  The seventeen upstream core designs additionally carry exact byte/SHA-256 locks.
